value.rationale: The first even-dimensional spherical two-design curve case is an explicitly open geometric length minimization problem. The result separates the infimum from the universal spectral lower bound by a uniform positive quantity, not just pointwise strict inequality, and gives an algebraic constant for every curve. The obstruction is a geometric fourth harmonic linked to covariance rank, not a routine substitution. No global optimizer or best constant is claimed; the numerical size of the gain is modest but the structural qualitative fact is a gap at an infimal threshold.
